product.name: VibeHacking
product.tagline: AI-Driven Cybersecurity & Hands-on Reverse Engineering Platform
product.description: VibeHacking is an open-source, comprehensive cybersecurity education platform featuring 75 modular curriculum sections (492 chapters), 67 interactive Docker labs, 79 guided wargame tracks, and 2,765 zero-defect challenges spanning Web, Cloud, Binary/Pwnable, AI Security, Cryptography, Forensics, and Confidential Computing.
product.first_comment:
Hello Product Hunt community! 👋

We are excited to share VibeHacking — an open-source cybersecurity and reverse engineering platform designed for engineers, security researchers, and students.

Key Highlights:
- 🛡️ 75 Complete Sections across Offensive & Defensive Security (492 in-depth chapters)
- 🐳 67 Hands-on Docker Environments (127.0.0.1 isolated with automated solvers)
- 🗺️ 79 Strategic Career Roadmap Tracks (Offensive, Cloud, AppSec, RE, PQC, TEE, AI Security)
- 🧩 2,765 Zero-Defect Wargame Challenges with deterministic verification
- 🤖 Autonomous AI Agent Skills (wargame builder, lab creator, remote publisher, compliance reporter)

Everything is 100% open source under MIT License. We'd love your feedback and contributions!
